top_papers.title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
top_papers.abstract: Attention remains a substantial computational cost in Transformer training, particularly at long context lengths. NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs provide high-throughput low-precision matrix multiplication, but exploiting it in attention requires addressing quantization overhead, causal information leakage through shared scales, and numerical inconsistencies between the forward and backward passes.
